programs.title: The Unbelievable With Dan Aykroyd
programs.desc: The world is full of strange and mind-bending places, but some take the cake. Explore an island ruled by deadly predators or a mysterious paranormal hotspot that's a magnet for UFOs and strange sightings.

programs.title: Dark Marvels
programs.desc: Since ancient times through the modern day, brutal games thrill both players and spectators. We explore the origins of history's deadliest games - from Roman bloodsports to Russian roulette.

programs.title: The Secret Of Skinwalker Ranch
programs.desc: Matty Blake meets with the team to delve deeper into the moment when they witnessed an unidentified aerial phenomenon entering a rocky mesa on the mysterious property known as Skinwalker Ranch.

programs.title: Hazardous History With Henry Winkler
programs.desc: Snack on a feast of food horrors from the past: from radioactive energy drinks to scandalous snacks made with Olestra, we uncover the incredible things people once ate without a second thought.

programs.title: Ancient Aliens
programs.desc: Ancient Aliens is counting down the top ten most devastating disasters ever documented that might have an otherworldly connection, including a flying monster at a nuclear incident.

programs.title: The Bermuda Triangle: Into Cursed Waters
programs.desc: The team investigates a large wooden shipwreck that could be one of the Bermuda Triangle area's earliest victims: the long-lost SS D.H. Mount.
